method: Official CLI with CLOUD_CODE_URL pointing to a loopback forwarding proxy; no ACP server or ACP protocol used

observations.toolContainerShape: One function declaration per tools[] element in these samples
observations.lastExecutionId: Absent in all five samples, including both tool continuations
observations.functionCallIds: Present and retained in both Gemini and Claude continuations
observations.sessionId: Same negative decimal int64-shaped string across the three independent CLI runs; derivation and lifetime not determined

limitations: Only low effort and the two named runtime models were exercised
Native endpoint selection was overridden by CLOUD_CODE_URL, not verified
The proxy changes transport framing and does not establish TLS-level client equivalence
No image generation, model switching, failed-request retry, concurrent calls, or conversation resume was exercised
Official prompts were used; acceptance of Pi prompts and the reported Pi false-429 cause remain unverified
Request identity generation rules cannot be inferred from the redacted shapes alone
These fixtures describe observations, not a replayable authenticated request or proof that every recorded field is required
redaction: Authorization and non-allowlisted header values removed; prompt text, tool descriptions, credentials, account/project identifiers, signatures, and other arbitrary string values replaced with length and truncated SHA-256 metadata
scopeNote: This records the first capture batch only. Consult verification.json for later findings; some original limitations were subsequently resolved.
